% !TeX program = pdflatex
%%% Page numbering: an unnumbered title page, roman numerals in the front matter, arabic from the first chapter, and appendices that continue the arabic sequence with appendixpages=false. pageofm counts to the last page of the document.
\documentclass[phd,appendixpages=false,12pt,a4paper]{bangorthesis}
\title{A Reasonably Sized Thesis Title}
\author{T. Student}
\degreescheme{Doctor of Philosophy}
\newcommand{\filler}{Body text that fills the page so that the chapter runs across several pages.}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\NewDocumentCommand{\fillpages}{m}{\prg_replicate:nn{#1}{\filler\par}}
\ExplSyntaxOff

\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{acknowledgements}
  Thanks to everyone.
\end{acknowledgements}
\begin{abstract}
  A short abstract.
\end{abstract}
\tableofcontents
\chapter{Introduction}
The command \texttt{\textbackslash cref} is set in typewriter type.

% The option list is one unbreakable word: the paragraph overfills a line without the emergency stretch that bangorlayout sets, so this fixture fails if the stretch is removed.
One document can turn several class options off at once by listing them together, as in \texttt{pageofm=false,appendixpages=false} here.
\fillpages{30}
\chapter{Methods}
\fillpages{20}
\appendix
\chapter{First appendix}
\fillpages{30}
\chapter{Second appendix}
\fillpages{20}
\end{document}
